_comment: Harness-relevant Prometheus series, kept in ONE place so a metric rename
on the rate-control branch is a one-line change here, not a code edit
The scraper keeps a scraped series when its name STARTS WITH one of the
base names below. Prefix matching absorbs any suffix the OpenTelemetry ->
Prometheus exporter appends (e.g. `_total`, a unit suffix such as
`_milliseconds`), so the base name written here matches whether or not the
exporter renames it. Verify the exact scraped names and the `origin` label
value against a live /metrics scrape before trusting a run: run
`./run_phase2.sh --probe` (or curl the endpoint) and confirm the names and
the origin label appear as expected. Discovered names are written to
